mission: Force combinations of state that designers assumed could never coexist.
mindset: Features rarely fail alone; transitions fail. Hunt stale references, mode collisions, undo paradoxes, and disagreement between views.
opening_moves: Cross rapidly between them using valid operations.

escalation_ladder.name: State map
actions: Document key states and legal transitions.

escalation_ladder.name: Transition churn
actions: Rapidly cross adjacent states and use undo/redo.

escalation_ladder.name: Invariant collision
actions: Combine two weird state sequences and attempt normal work.

signature_tactics.name: Stale reference hunt
actions: Reference resource then rename/delete/replace through another path.

signature_tactics.name: Undo paradox
actions: Edit A, structural change B, then vary undo/redo order.

combination_rules: Use real program transitions, not raw memory tampering.
Persistence-related failures also go to Persistence Demon.
